It says "The build process will watch..." after npm start, but doesn't explicitly say dev server runs. Need verify: open browser localhost:8080. Build output at dist. Deploy gh-pages branch requires gh-pages package maybe not listed? It says npm run deploy but no prerequisite for GitHub auth? Not needed for install.
